description: Re-run Mapled's server checks on a setup run after fixing something: the site must read content with the delivery key; a publish webhook that is configured must have delivered and /api/mapled/preview must respond (neither set up yet — a warning, not a failure: both are optional); the created fields should have help texts; each page of the page map, read again from the site, must show 90 % or more from Mapled (the detail quotes what isn't). Returns each check with a detail line.
name: verify_setup
